summary.labels: All costs are ESTIMATES (method B): published Sonnet-tier list prices applied to measured, undifferentiated subagent token totals (upper bound incl. agent overhead). Accuracy is exact vs the answer key.

F.designed: deterministic parse fails validation -> falls back to the LLM

R.designed: deterministic after the type's parser activates (discovery docs LLM by construction)

S.designed: parses deterministically, passes all checks, silently wrong vs the answer key

V.designed: stays on the LLM path (below the learning threshold)

deviations_from_design: FBL1N F-class (5 docs): designed to fall back; actually parsed correctly on the deterministic path (currency-general parser). Accepted and frozen.

pricing_reference.note: Introductory pricing ($2/$10) runs through 2026-08-31; estimates use standard list prices. subagent_tokens are undifferentiated totals, so costs are computed as a BAND (all-input floor to all-output ceiling) plus a central estimate assuming an 85/15 input/output split (agent sessions are input-heavy). All figures are estimates and labelled as such.
